blue.name: Paper cooperative seed — replace with selected PGG C*
rules: Contribute at least 60% of your wallet each round.
Reduce contributions if the group average contribution fraction falls below 30%.
Punish agents contributing less than 10% for at least two rounds.
Match or exceed the group average contribution fraction.

red_seed.name: Neutral starting rules
rules: Observe the public game history and available actions before deciding.
Choose a valid action within your available wallet.
